gaps.sentence: She got ___ injury during the warm-up.
gaps.explanation: 'An injury' — vowel sound; 'during the warm-up' is the specific one.

gaps.sentence: She's studying history at ___ University of Vienna.
gaps.explanation: University names with of-phrases take the: the University of Vienna.

gaps.sentence: He was sent to ___ prison for armed robbery.
gaps.explanation: 'Be sent to prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article; visiting the building is 'go to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.
'MA' is pronounced /em/, starting with a vowel sound, so 'an MA'.

gaps.sentence: ___ bicycles are a cheap way of seeing the city.
gaps.explanation: Plural nouns in a general sense take no article.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ heir to a shipping fortune.
gaps.explanation: 'Heir' begins with a vowel sound — the h is silent.

gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.
